checks.subject: Correct quantified claim
checks.assessment: The final opening explicitly says a member of the endpoint-zero full nonnegative even-sextic family exists that satisfies the four windows. The proof and result establish nonemptiness and model-degree sensitivity, not universal satisfaction by all unconstrained sextics or a measured full physical angular law.

checks.subject: Dimensions and input conditions
checks.assessment: mu,z and the geometric basis integrals are dimensionless; coefficients and D carry the DCS unit nb/sr; the aperture ratio is dimensionless. Rest energies and photon energy are in MeV. D is a conditional angular normalization, not a newly established event total cross section. Four nominal-angle deterministic ERR-S windows and the separate M0475003 grid are preserved.

checks.subject: Actual result fidelity
checks.assessment: Fixed candidate, r minimum, positive D, exact endpoint zeros, four-window admission, six nonempty cases, 24,690 bases, four nested inclusions and exact FULL=1 agree with previously reviewed raw records. All quoted outward ranges and finite bracket widths agree.

checks.subject: Case-level counting
checks.assessment: 26 is explicitly 14 inner plus 12 outer certificate vertex occurrences across six cases, not a globally unique vertex count. N4 and N16 respective vertex lists and results are identical in this saved run.

checks.subject: Uncertainty and finite resolution
checks.assessment: Approximately 1e-14 extremum certificate widths are distinguished from the broad model-dependent probability range and from deterministic experimental ERR-S windows. N1 CAPS maximum bracket remains finite and wider. Finite N4/N16 equality is not promoted into a general convergence or finite-N completeness theorem.

checks.subject: Source and survey accuracy
checks.assessment: Repository census, bounded PR read scope and selected body-read counts agree with the saved survey. Backup counts and Drive/private-context gaps agree with COVERAGE_AND_DECISIONS. Literature citations and access restrictions agree with PRIMARY_SUPPORT_KO; publisher metadata/abstract access is not called full-text access or degree6 physical-law confirmation. Official M0475 source identity and dd reaction had already been directly reviewed.

checks.subject: Evidence roles and actual resource scope
checks.assessment: Same-author producer/reader code paths are distinguished from nonauthor scientific review. One construction, 8 PASS/0 FAIL, one evaluator with 14 zeros/16 True including two sign controls, and one saved-only plot are correctly reported. Local whole-run CPU/wall are separated from unknown remote CAS resources and external delivery costs.

checks.subject: Display limitation

checks.subject: Failures and allowances
